##  Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware
This research explores the energy efficiency of large language models (LLMs) when deployed on consumer hardware.  LLMs are getting bigger and more powerful, which means they consume more energy.  This study looks at how much power these models use when running on your typical desktop or laptop.  It's a crucial area to study as the energy demands of AI are growing.
The study uses a benchmark to measure the power consumption of different LLMs on consumer hardware.  The study is preliminary and doesn't yet prove that these models are more efficient.  It's important to note that this research is just a starting point and more work is needed to understand the full impact of LLMs on energy consumption.
